identity.description: An attacker uses a Windows endpoint to access a network device's management interface via Telnet or SSH, potentially leveraging stolen credentials or brute force. Cortex should detect the unusual process execution and network connection patterns associated with this behavior.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to target device management interface

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Internal Access to Management Interface
biocs.description: Detection of a process accessing a network device management interface from an internal host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter dst_port = 23
